% Generated by build.py - QR codes for the thesis videos
% Requires in the preamble:
%   \usepackage{xcolor,tikz}
%   \usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}
%   \usepackage{qrcode}
%   \usepackage{hyperref}
\newcommand{\thesisvideobase}{https://edforti.github.io/thesis-video}
\definecolor{videoaccent}{RGB}{31,95,168}
% \thesisvideo{<slug>}{<title>}: framed box, text on the left, QR code on the right
\newcommand{\thesisvideo}[2]{%
  \par\smallskip
  \begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, width=0.78\linewidth, center,
      colback=black!5, colframe=black!15, boxrule=0.4pt, arc=2pt,
      borderline west={2.5pt}{0pt}{videoaccent},
      left=10pt, right=8pt, top=6pt, bottom=6pt,
      sidebyside, sidebyside align=center, sidebyside gap=8pt,
      lefthand width=\dimexpr0.78\linewidth-2.9cm\relax, segmentation hidden]
    \raggedright
    {\color{videoaccent}\tikz[baseline=-0.6ex]{\fill (0,0) circle (1.1ex);
       \fill[white] (-0.35ex,-0.55ex) -- (-0.35ex,0.55ex) -- (0.6ex,0) -- cycle;}%
     \hspace{0.4em}\large\bfseries\sffamily Video}\par\smallskip
    {\normalsize #2}\par\medskip
    {\footnotesize\color{black!60} Scan the QR code or
      \hypersetup{pdfborder={0 0 0}}\href{\thesisvideobase/#1/}{\color{videoaccent}click here}
      to watch.}
    \tcblower
    \centering\qrcode[height=2.3cm,level=M,nolink]{\thesisvideobase/#1/}
  \end{tcolorbox}\par}
